newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian industry minister visits Libya next month to sign agreements for joint projects.
- Saudi's al-Zamil group invests $29 million in a chemical project in the Saudi eastern province.
- Jordanian tourism ministry plans projects worth $26 million.
- Emirates Industrial Bank urges review of a decision to halt granting licences to ready-made clothes business.
